stt: Ask HN: Favorite fiction books of 2018?
x: The First Law trilogy by Joe Abercrombie (the Blade Itself, Before They Are Hanged, and the Last Argument of Kings). They're quite dark but surprisingly funny and maybe the most readable novels I've ever read. Absolute page-turners.

stt: Ask HN: What's the best book you read in 2021?
x:
I found The First Law books to be fantastic: https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/944073.The_Blade_Itself

(You can tell The Blade Itself is a first novel — but the following novels are A+.)

I had given up on fiction for a few years, but tried it out after coming across a thread on Reddit. The audiobooks in the series are incredibly good — in fact, I've recently just been reading anything that the narrator (Steven Pacey) has done in the past.
